title: Chapter 187: The Strength Of The Zerg
content:
Chapter 187: The Strength Of The Zerg

Except for the one-star leader of the Tengu army responsible for blockade and search, the rest are ordinary troops. It can be seen from this that the Tengu disciple who was stabbed by Gou Shu did not have a high status and could only fight under ordinary soldiers. Show off your authority in front of others.

"Catch them all first! If you need anything, I'll take care of it!"

The man was not afraid of threats and ordered the soldiers to arrest people.

The defenders of these large cities were all arrogant soldiers who could not see the strength gap between the two sides and took action upon receiving orders.

"Don't kill anyone!"

This is Wu Qing's request. These bug people seem to be no different from normal people, but they are still bugs in nature. When fighting, they are quite ferocious.

The Silkworm Knight is not only a powerful knight, but the Zerg war horse is also as powerful as the knight.

Facing the incoming enemy, the ten Zerg war horses roared, stood upright, and landed heavily with their front hooves. The sound was very frightening. They charged forward, and the Tengu army fell to the ground, unable to fight back.

The Celestial Silkworm Knight just controlled his horse and charged, without even taking out his scabbard, and the surrounding Tengu Clan troops were scattered.

Gou Shu, who was surrounded by the Tengu army, transformed into weapons and was about to fight to the death. He was also shocked by the powerful strength of the Celestial Silkworm Knight. He fainted and was caught on horseback by a Celestial Silkworm Knight.

"These Zerg Celestial Silkworm Knights are very powerful!"

"The defenders in the city are no match at all!"

"Fortunately, they have no intention of killing anyone, otherwise this place would be filled with blood!"

"They haven't left yet! The masters from the city will be here soon!"

"With their strength and background, they shouldn't be afraid!"

"I wonder why this became a conflict? Is there any clarity?"

"Didn't you just talk about the sneak attack? Let's see what's hidden in it! It's exciting now!"

"I'm a little curious about the techniques passed down by these Celestial Silkworm Knights. I wonder what their inheritance standards are? How to identify talents?"

"They are so strong, their inheritance will definitely not be weak!"

"..."

The people watching around were not making general comments.

Ordinary residents dare not come out to watch this kind of excitement. Those who can watch are people who are not afraid of trouble. They don't need to be taboo when talking.

The Celestial Silkworm Knight had already rushed to the person who ordered them to be captured. A sheathed long knife was instantly pressed against the man's neck, just below the dog's head.

"Perfect riding skills! Superb sword skills!"

Some people who are not weak in strength applaud the skills of the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights.

The captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights looked at the man under the sword and said calmly: "Tell them to stop, we don't want to kill anyone!"

"We have just entered the city. We don't know what happened here. Let's let the person involved tell us!"

Feeling the approaching chill of the scabbard, the man waved his hand to signal the Tengu army to stop attacking.

"To put it bluntly, I haven't seen you for just a few days, how come you have changed from a man of great merit to a felon being rounded up?"

"You tell me the cause and effect. As long as it makes sense, our lord will make the decision for you!"

"My Zerg army is counterattacking the Evil God's camp! Our Zerg reinforcements are fighting in the Naga territory! Our lord has the strength to make the decision for you!"

The voice of the Captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knights was not loud, but it was very clear and could be heard clearly by the people around him.

He is the threat of Chiluoluo. He released the news that the Zerg are counterattacking the Evil God camp and assisting the Naga tribe, just to tell everyone that if they offend the Zerg, they can turn their guns at any time and attack the territory of the Tengu tribe.

This is a threat to the Tengu clan, and it is also publicity to the outside world. If others don’t publicize these major things done by the Zerg clan, then they should publicize it themselves.

Facts are facts, and as long as these news get out, someone will always have a way to verify the truth.

"No wonder the war has eased recently. It turns out that this new Zerg race is counterattacking the evil god's camp!"

"I wonder why the current defenders still have time to arrest people everywhere. It turns out there is no war to fight!"

"The Zerg tribe still has the strength to send troops to support the Naga tribe in their operations. They have this kind of strength when they first entered the world. When it develops, it will be really amazing!"

"When these Celestial Silkworm Knights enter the world, they should be able to quickly increase the strength of the Zerg race. This is a great opportunity for many people!"

"Every time a real big clan enters the world, a legendary story will be staged! It is even more extraordinary for the Zerg to choose this time to enter the world!"

“It’s really exciting!”

"..."

In large cities, there are many knowledgeable people. By listening to other people's gossip, Wu Qing can get a lot of information that he would not be able to ask people in person.

Gou Shu was put down by the Celestial Silkworm Knight and stood in a conspicuous place.

After listening to the words of the captain of the Celestial Silkworm Knight, he looked around and said to the Celestial Silkworm Knight: "This is what happened!"

"Speak louder so everyone can hear!"

"If you don't explain this clearly, your family will also be implicated!"

Captain Tiancan Knight reminded Gou Shu loudly.

Gou Shu thought about it and realized that it was indeed the case, so he no longer hesitated and told the whole story loudly.

The Tengu army at the scene was just a city defender, responsible for arresting people, and had no idea what was going on. The onlookers around were about to watch the show unfold, and they all listened to Gou Shu's story very quietly.

When Gou told the beginning, many people knew that this was another bloody story that could not be brought to the table. This kind of thing exists in many places, especially in the Tiangu clan's territory, but it is generally not mentioned.

This time, the two idiots, the Zerg Silkworm Knight and Gou Shu, brought it up in public, and also indicated that a powerful lord of a newly rising clan would intervene, which really made the Tengu clan lose face.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

"Very good! A little playboy of the Tengu clan dared to repeatedly murder the meritorious people personally taught by our clan lord!"

"To kill someone! To steal someone's wife! This hatred is irreconcilable!"

"Gou Shu, you did a great job! The lord didn't misjudge you!"

"I will seek justice for you on behalf of the lord!"

The captain of the Silkworm Knight glanced at the Tengu army present and said solemnly.

"Gou Shu, to prove that you are a meritorious person personally taught by the Lord, you should show everyone what the Lord has personally given you!"

"Yes!"

Gou Shu stood in the open space, skillfully demonstrated the magic of the Zerg biological reproductive suit, and also performed a set of combat skills he had practiced under the guidance of the biological reproductive suit.

Those who know the business immediately discovered the great value of the Zerg biological reproductive suit.

"I rely on the magical equipment personally given by the Lord to repeatedly escape danger at critical moments. It is the Lord who gave me the opportunity to regenerate!"

Gou Shu finished demonstrating the Zerg biological reproductive suit to his heart's content, and said to the Heavenly Silkworm Knight with gratitude.

"After this happened to you, it seems that you can't stay in the Tengu tribe!"

"Wait for this matter, I will teach you the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm, and with the biological breeding suit given by the Lord, strive to become a Heavenly Silkworm Knight as soon as possible!"

"Watch it!"

The captain of the Heavenly Silkworm Knight pointed at the sheathed long sword of the man who ordered the action, and it instantly turned into a dark spear. He shook his hand, and the spear head turned into a phantom, which scattered all the fine armor on the Tengu tribe member to the ground without hurting the man at all.

"Good spearmanship! Good equipment!"

Someone among the onlookers shouted loudly.

"Thank you for your support, Lord Guard!"

Gou Shu thanked excitedly.

The spear played by the captain of the Heavenly Silkworm Knight was actually used by Wu Qing. Wu Qing could easily possess a two-star insect man and exert some combat power.

The real insect man, although the combat power is not weak, cannot use such skillful human martial arts.

Wu Qing personally took action to make the first appearance of the Silkworm Knight astonish everyone.

The transmission of information between large cities in this world is relatively fast. After long-term development and research, many forces and organizations have their own secret methods for rapid transmission of information.

Many forces and organizations rely on unique secret methods and channels for information transmission to survive, and their news is the most well-informed.

Therefore, Wu Qing will personally pay attention to the first official appearance of the Silkworm Knight on behalf of the Zerg.

"What is your identity? I am now representing the Zerg to formally negotiate with the Tengu Clan!"

"Please let someone with status come out to talk! This is a conflict between the two major clans, and it is not a joke!"

The captain of the Silkworm Knight said coldly to the Tengu Clan member who was frightened by his armor being picked off.

"I will have someone report it now! Please wait for a moment, Lord Silkworm Knight!"

The head of the Tengu Clan who was originally responsible for the blockade came to the rescue and immediately sent someone to report. The current situation here is no longer something they can handle.

The first to arrive was the elder of the man who was stabbed by Gou Shu. He rode a lizard mount and brought a team of cavalry to the scene.

He had spies on the periphery and had roughly known the situation here.

"The murderer was caught? How did you do it? And you had a conflict with the guests from the Zerg!?"

The visitor looked like a middle-aged Tengu, with a sense of pride.

He first identified Gou Shu as the murderer, and then scolded his own people.

He turned around and wanted to speak to the Silkworm Knight.

"No need to say more! My Zerg is not good at intrigue!"

"I represent the Zerg, and I only need the Tengu to give an explanation, and the results will be reported to the Lord truthfully!"

"Everything will be decided by the Lord!"

"Can you speak for the Tengu?!"

The captain of the Silkworm Knight interrupted the visitor and asked him.

The arrogant middle-aged Tengu, with a word in his heart, changed his face, and finally stepped aside and did not speak again.

The high-profile face-slapping behavior of the Silkworm Knight brought shame to the entire Tengu tribe. Even though he said he represented the Zerg, he did not wait for the real high-level figures of the Tengu tribe.

Only one sentence came: "Both parties are at fault, and neither side will be held accountable. The matter is over!"

This is a compromise, which is equivalent to saying nothing.

"Very good! I will report the attitude of the Tengu tribe truthfully!"

The Silkworm Knight did not dwell on this matter any more.
